title: kithd: graceful shutdown on SIGTERM
description: Create kithd::signal module. pub async fn shutdown_signal(): use tokio::signal::ctrl_c() for Ctrl-C; cfg(unix) use signal(SignalKind::terminate()) for SIGTERM; tokio::select! on whichever fires first; log 'received shutdown signal' at INFO. pub mod signal added to lib.rs. No sensitive data logged in shutdown path.
